import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector

# --- CLEAR ---
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()
for col in list(bpy.data.collections):
    if col.name != "Collection":
        pass
# purge
for m in list(bpy.data.meshes): bpy.data.meshes.remove(m)
for m in list(bpy.data.materials): bpy.data.materials.remove(m)
for m in list(bpy.data.curves): bpy.data.curves.remove(m)

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
scene.eevee.use_soft_shadows = True
# world
world = bpy.data.worlds['World']
world.use_nodes = True
bg = world.node_tree.nodes['Background']
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.12,0.14,0.28,1)
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 0.6

# --- MATERIALS helper ---
def mat(name, color, rough=0.7, metallic=0.0, emit=None, emit_strength=0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color,1)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if emit:
        # use emission via principled in Blender 4/5 : Emission Color
        try:
            bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emit,1)
            bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = emit_strength
        except: pass
    return m

M = {}
M['octo'] = mat('OctoSkin',(0.92,0.32,0.38),0.45)
M['octo_light'] = mat('OctoLight',(1.0,0.75,0.70),0.5)
M['octo_dark'] = mat('OctoDark',(0.78,0.20,0.28),0.5)
M['white'] = mat('White',(0.98,0.98,0.97),0.35)
M['black'] = mat('Black',(0.05,0.05,0.08),0.3)
M['wood_dark'] = mat('WoodDark',(0.36,0.20,0.11),0.8)
M['wood'] = mat('Wood',(0.62,0.38,0.20),0.75)
M['wood_light'] = mat('WoodLight',(0.85,0.62,0.36),0.7)
M['red'] = mat('AwningRed',(0.85,0.18,0.18),0.6)
M['red_dark'] = mat('RedDark',(0.65,0.10,0.12),0.6)
M['indigo'] = mat('NorenIndigo',(0.13,0.22,0.55),0.85)
M['cream'] = mat('Cream',(0.98,0.92,0.78),0.6)
M['lantern'] = mat('Lantern',(1.0,0.88,0.65),0.4, emit=(1.0,0.65,0.25), emit_strength=0.9)
M['lantern_red'] = mat('LanternRed',(0.95,0.25,0.20),0.4, emit=(0.9,0.2,0.1), emit_strength=0.35)
M['metal'] = mat('Metal',(0.75,0.78,0.82),0.25, metallic=0.9)
M['metal_dark'] = mat('MetalDark',(0.25,0.27,0.32),0.4, metallic=0.6)
M['broth'] = mat('Broth',(0.92,0.62,0.18),0.25)
M['noodle'] = mat('Noodle',(0.98,0.84,0.48),0.5)
M['egg_white'] = mat('EggWhite',(0.99,0.97,0.92),0.4)
M['egg_yolk'] = mat('EggYolk',(0.98,0.62,0.08),0.35)
M['green'] = mat('Scallion',(0.25,0.72,0.30),0.6)
M['pink'] = mat('NarutoPink',(0.98,0.55,0.65),0.5)
M['char'] = mat('Chashu',(0.72,0.38,0.22),0.6)
M['bowl_blue'] = mat('BowlBlue',(0.15,0.35,0.75),0.3)
M['bowl_white'] = mat('BowlWhite',(0.96,0.95,0.93),0.25)
M['ground'] = mat('Ground',(0.22,0.24,0.34),0.9)
M['stone'] = mat('Stone',(0.45,0.47,0.54),0.85)
M['gold'] = mat('Gold',(0.98,0.72,0.15),0.3, metallic=0.6)
M['blush'] = mat('Blush',(0.98,0.45,0.55),0.6)

def link_mat(obj, material):
    if obj.data and hasattr(obj.data,'materials'):
        obj.data.materials.append(material)

def box(name, loc, scale, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale
    # cube default size 2, so scale is half-size; keep as is: we pass half extents via scale directly? Use dimensions
    # Instead set dimensions: scale param interpreted as (sx,sy,sz) where actual size =2*scale? Let's set via scale and apply conceptually - keep visual
    link_mat(o, material)
    # bevel modifier for soft edges
    mod=o.modifiers.new('bev','BEVEL'); mod.width=0.02; mod.segments=2
    return o

def box_dim(name, loc, dims, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    o.dimensions=dims
    link_mat(o, material)
    mod=o.modifiers.new('bev','BEVEL'); mod.width=0.015; mod.segments=2
    return o

def cyl(name, loc, radius, depth, material, rot=(0,0,0), verts=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; link_mat(o, material)
    return o

def sphere(name, loc, scale, material, seg=24):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=seg, ring_count=16, location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; link_mat(o, material)
    bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    return o

def cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; link_mat(o, material)
    return o

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, material, rot=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor, major_segments=32, minor_segments=12, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; link_mat(o, material)
    bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    return o

# Taper curve for tentacles
taper_data = bpy.data.curves.new('TaperCurve','CURVE')
taper_data.dimensions='2D'
sp = taper_data.splines.new('BEZIER')
sp.bezier_points.add(2)
sp.bezier_points[0].co=(-1,0.18,0); sp.bezier_points[0].handle_left_type='AUTO'; sp.bezier_points[0].handle_right_type='AUTO'
sp.bezier_points[1].co=(0,0.55,0); sp.bezier_points[1].handle_left_type='AUTO'; sp.bezier_points[1].handle_right_type='AUTO'
sp.bezier_points[2].co=(1,1.0,0); sp.bezier_points[2].handle_left_type='AUTO'; sp.bezier_points[2].handle_right_type='AUTO'
# Note: taper curve X is along length, Y is radius scale. We want thick at base (start) thin at tip.
# Blender taper: start of spline corresponds to curve start. We'll orient points so first point of tentacle is base.
# So taper should go 1.0 -> 0.25. Adjust:
sp.bezier_points[0].co=(-1,1.0,0)
sp.bezier_points[1].co=(0,0.55,0)
sp.bezier_points[2].co=(1,0.18,0)
taper_obj = bpy.data.objects.new('TaperObj', taper_data)
bpy.context.collection.objects.link(taper_obj)
taper_obj.hide_render=True; taper_obj.hide_viewport=True

def tentacle(name, pts, radius=0.16, material=None):
    cu = bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE')
    cu.dimensions='3D'
    cu.resolution_u=12
    cu.bevel_depth=radius
    cu.bevel_resolution=6
    cu.taper_object=taper_obj
    cu.use_fill_caps=True
    spline = cu.splines.new('BEZIER')
    spline.bezier_points.add(len(pts)-1)
    for i,p in enumerate(pts):
        bp=spline.bezier_points[i]
        bp.co=p
        bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name, cu)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    if material: cu.materials.append(material)
    # convert to mesh for GLB
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=ob
    ob.select_set(True)
    bpy.ops.object.convert(target='MESH')
    ob=bpy.context.active_object
    ob.name=name
    bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    ob.select_set(False)
    return ob

def noodle_strand(name, pts, radius=0.025):
    return tentacle(name, pts, radius=radius, material=M['noodle'])

# ================= GROUND & BOOTH =================
# Ground disc / street
cyl('Ground',(0,0,-0.12), 7.5, 0.24, M['ground'], verts=48)
cyl('GroundTrim',(0,0,-0.02), 7.5, 0.06, M['stone'], verts=48)
# wooden deck platform under booth
box_dim('Deck',(0,0.6,0.08),(7.2,4.6,0.16), M['wood_dark'])
# deck planks lines (thin boxes)
for i in range(7):
    x=-3.3+i*1.1
    box_dim(f'Plank{i}',(x,0.6,0.17),(0.06,4.6,0.02), M['wood'])

# Counter: front panel + top
box_dim('CounterFront',(0,-0.2,0.65),(6.4,0.18,1.0), M['wood'])
box_dim('CounterSideL',(-3.15,0.45,0.65),(0.18,1.5,1.0), M['wood'])
box_dim('CounterSideR',(3.15,0.45,0.65),(0.18,1.5,1.0), M['wood'])
box_dim('CounterTop',(0,0.35,1.22),(6.8,1.7,0.14), M['wood_light'])
# counter front slats
for i in range(9):
    x=-2.8+i*0.7
    box_dim(f'Slat{i}',(x,-0.32,0.65),(0.45,0.06,0.85), M['wood_dark'])
# back shelf
box_dim('BackShelf',(0,1.95,1.05),(6.4,0.7,0.1), M['wood_light'])
box_dim('BackPanel',(0,2.3,0.7),(6.4,0.15,1.1), M['wood_dark'])

# Posts
for sx,sy in [(-3.2,-0.35),(3.2,-0.35),(-3.2,2.2),(3.2,2.2)]:
    cyl(f'Post{sx}{sy}',(sx,sy,1.95),0.11,3.6,M['wood_dark'],verts=12)
# Roof: slanted top
box_dim('RoofMain',(0,0.9,3.95),(7.6,3.8,0.16), M['red_dark'], rot=(math.radians(10),0,0))
box_dim('RoofRidge',(0,1.05,4.18),(7.7,0.35,0.18), M['wood_dark'], rot=(math.radians(10),0,0))
# roof underside beams
box_dim('BeamFront',(0,-0.35,3.55),(6.8,0.18,0.22), M['wood_dark'])
box_dim('BeamBack',(0,2.2,3.75),(6.8,0.18,0.22), M['wood_dark'])
# Awning valance stripes front
for i in range(11):
    x=-3.3+i*0.66
    m = M['red'] if i%2==0 else M['white']
    box_dim(f'Valance{i}',(x,-0.55,3.55),(0.62,0.05,0.55), m)
# Noren curtain (3 flaps) under front beam, behind valance slightly
for i, x in enumerate([-2.2,0,2.2]):
    box_dim(f'Noren{i}',(x,-0.28,2.85),(2.05,0.06,1.15), M['indigo'])
    # white circle crest
    cyl(f'NorenCrest{i}',(x,-0.33,3.0),0.28,0.02,M['white'],rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
    cyl(f'NorenDot{i}',(x,-0.35,3.0),0.12,0.02,M['red'],rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))

# Sign board on roof front
box_dim('SignBoard',(0,-0.75,4.05),(3.6,0.12,0.75), M['wood_light'], rot=(math.radians(8),0,0))
box_dim('SignTrim',(0,-0.78,4.05),(3.75,0.08,0.88), M['wood_dark'], rot=(math.radians(8),0,0))
# Sign text approximation: 3 red circles + bars mimicking kanji blocks
for i,x in enumerate([-1.0,0,1.0]):
    box_dim(f'Kanji{i}a',(x,-0.86,4.12),(0.55,0.05,0.10), M['red_dark'])
    box_dim(f'Kanji{i}b',(x,-0.86,3.98),(0.10,0.05,0.38), M['red_dark'])
    box_dim(f'Kanji{i}c',(x,-0.86,3.90),(0.45,0.05,0.08), M['red_dark'])

# Lanterns hanging front (5)
lantern_x=[-2.7,-1.35,0,1.35,2.7]
for i,x in enumerate(lantern_x):
    cyl(f'LanternString{i}',(x,-0.45,3.15),0.015,0.35,M['black'])
    # lantern body: squashed sphere
    sphere(f'Lantern{i}',(x,-0.45,2.82),(0.26,0.26,0.22), M['lantern'] if i%2==0 else M['lantern_red'])
    cyl(f'LanternTop{i}',(x,-0.45,3.02),0.10,0.06,M['black'])
    cyl(f'LanternBot{i}',(x,-0.45,2.62),0.10,0.06,M['black'])
    # ribs
    torus(f'LanternRib{i}',(x,-0.45,2.82),0.255,0.012, M['red_dark'] if i%2==0 else M['white'])

# Stools in front (4)
for i,x in enumerate([-2.4,-0.8,0.8,2.4]):
    cyl(f'StoolTop{i}',(x,-1.55,0.72),0.34,0.09,M['red'])
    cyl(f'StoolLeg{i}',(x,-1.55,0.36),0.06,0.72,M['wood_dark'])
    cyl(f'StoolBase{i}',(x,-1.55,0.06),0.24,0.08,M['wood_dark'])

# Menu board standing right side
box_dim('MenuBoard',(3.9,-0.9,0.95),(0.08,1.0,1.5), M['wood_dark'], rot=(0,0,math.radians(-18)))
box_dim('MenuPaper',(3.85,-0.9,1.0),(0.04,0.85,1.25), M['cream'], rot=(0,0,math.radians(-18)))
box_dim('MenuLeg1',(3.95,-1.35,0.25),(0.07,0.07,0.5), M['wood_dark'])
box_dim('MenuLeg2',(3.95,-0.45,0.25),(0.07,0.07,0.5), M['wood_dark'])
# menu lines
for i in range(4):
    box_dim(f'MenuLine{i}',(3.82,-0.9,1.38-i*0.22),(0.02,0.6,0.07), M['red_dark'], rot=(0,0,math.radians(-18)))

# Crates / props left
box_dim('Crate1',(-3.9,0.9,0.35),(0.9,0.9,0.7), M['wood'])
box_dim('Crate2',(-3.85,0.85,1.0),(0.8,0.8,0.6), M['wood_light'], rot=(0,0,0.2))
# sake / spice jars on back shelf
jar_colors=[M['red'],M['cream'],M['indigo'],M['gold'],M['white'],M['red']]
for i,x in enumerate([-2.6,-1.9,-1.2,1.4,2.1,2.7]):
    cyl(f'Jar{i}',(x,1.95,1.32),0.16,0.42,jar_colors[i])
    cyl(f'JarLid{i}',(x,1.95,1.56),0.18,0.07,M['wood_dark'])
# stacked bowls on counter left
for i in range(3):
    cyl(f'StackBowl{i}',(-2.55,0.15,1.38+i*0.11),0.26-i*0.01,0.12,M['bowl_white'])
    torus(f'StackRim{i}',(-2.55,0.15,1.44+i*0.11),0.26,0.02,M['bowl_blue'])

# ================= RAMEN POT (left-center behind counter) =================
pot_pos=(-1.55,1.05,1.29)
cyl('PotBody',pot_pos,0.55,0.62,M['metal'],verts=32)
cyl('PotRim',(-1.55,1.05,1.62),0.58,0.06,M['metal_dark'],verts=32)
cyl('PotBroth',(-1.55,1.05,1.60),0.50,0.04,M['broth'],verts=32)
# burner
cyl('Burner',(-1.55,1.05,0.95),0.38,0.12,M['metal_dark'])
# handles
torus('PotHandleL',(-2.12,1.05,1.45),0.14,0.03,M['metal_dark'],rot=(0,math.radians(90),0))
torus('PotHandleR',(-0.98,1.05,1.45),0.14,0.03,M['metal_dark'],rot=(0,math.radians(90),0))
# steam puffs (small white spheres, soft)
steam_mat = mat('Steam',(0.95,0.96,1.0),0.9)
for i,(dx,dy,dz,s) in enumerate([(-0.15,0,0.35,0.16),(0.1,0.08,0.62,0.20),(-0.05,-0.1,0.88,0.15),(0.18,-0.05,0.48,0.13)]):
    sphere(f'Steam{i}',(pot_pos[0]+dx,pot_pos[1]+dy,1.65+dz),(s,s*0.8,s),steam_mat)

# Helper to make a ramen bowl
def ramen_bowl(prefix, loc, scale=1.0, with_noodles_lift=False):
    x,y,z=loc
    s=scale
    cone(prefix+'Bowl',(x,y,z+0.09*s),0.34*s,0.16*s,0.20*s,M['bowl_white'])
    torus(prefix+'Rim',(x,y,z+0.19*s),0.34*s,0.025*s,M['bowl_blue'])
    cyl(prefix+'Broth',(x,y,z+0.17*s),0.30*s,0.03*s,M['broth'])
    # noodle mound
    sphere(prefix+'Noodles',(x,y,z+0.20*s),(0.24*s,0.24*s,0.09*s),M['noodle'])
    # egg half
    sphere(prefix+'EggW',(x+0.12*s,y-0.10*s,z+0.24*s),(0.09*s,0.11*s,0.05*s),M['egg_white'])
    sphere(prefix+'EggY',(x+0.12*s,y-0.10*s,z+0.27*s),(0.05*s,0.05*s,0.03*s),M['egg_yolk'])
    # narutomaki
    cyl(prefix+'Naruto',(x-0.13*s,y+0.07*s,z+0.25*s),0.065*s,0.03*s,M['white'],rot=(0.4,0,0))
    cyl(prefix+'NarutoP',(x-0.13*s,y+0.06*s,z+0.26*s),0.035*s,0.032*s,M['pink'],rot=(0.4,0,0))
    # chashu slice
    cyl(prefix+'Chashu',(x-0.05*s,y-0.14*s,z+0.24*s),0.10*s,0.03*s,M['char'],rot=(0.3,0.2,0))
    # scallions
    for j in range(5):
        ang=j*1.26
        sphere(prefix+f'Scall{j}',(x+math.cos(ang)*0.11*s,y+math.sin(ang)*0.11*s,z+0.27*s),(0.03*s,0.03*s,0.02*s),M['green'])
    # nori sheet
    box_dim(prefix+'Nori',(x+0.18*s,y+0.12*s,z+0.28*s),(0.16*s,0.02*s,0.20*s), M['black'], rot=(0,0,0.3))
    return (x,y,z)

# Bowls on counter for customers
ramen_bowl('Cust1',(-1.65,-0.25,1.29),1.0)
ramen_bowl('Cust2',(0.15,-0.30,1.29),1.0)
ramen_bowl('Cust3',(1.85,-0.25,1.29),0.95)
# bowl held will be placed separately near tentacle

# Chopsticks resting on Cust2
cyl('ChopRest1',(0.25,-0.55,1.52),0.018,0.55,M['wood_dark'],rot=(math.radians(75),0,math.radians(20)))
cyl('ChopRest2',(0.32,-0.55,1.52),0.018,0.55,M['wood_dark'],rot=(math.radians(75),0,math.radians(20)))

# Small condiment jars on counter
for i,(x,c) in enumerate([( -0.75,M['red']),( -0.45,M['white']),(1.05,M['gold'])]):
